inputs.text: [excited] It was 18 feet long — as long as a big SUV! Standing up, it was 11 feet tall — [amazed] as tall as two Dads standing on each other's shoulders! And it weighed 5,000 kilos — [proud] as heavy as an elephant!
[confident] Sweeping away snow. [amazed] Its two curved tusks could be over 13 feet long — longer than Dad lying flat on the ground.
